correctness.rationale: Uniform recurrence follows since both images contain both letters. The telescoping-sum argument forces 01 and 10 ordered endpoint pairs at each positive distance. The exact image-boundary decomposition and pointwise prefix order then attain both proposed extrema for every offset; sliding-window sums interpolate every integer. The proof excludes all possible least periods for the explicit block-run family using column-map identities/constants/complements. Standalone finite tests verify formulas but are not used as a proof.

originality.rationale: The closest fully inspected 2024 primary article proves automaticity for arbitrary Parikh-collinear images and explicitly leaves ultimate periodicity for Parikh-constant fixed points as an open question. The present sufficient condition supplies exact residue-wise extrema and aperiodic examples. The 2023 predecessor supplies only automaticity and a counterexample outside equal-Parikh images. Later 2025 automaticity for Pisot-type substitutions does not imply this periodicity formula; the 2026 characterization concerns abelian periodicity of words, not periodicity of their complexity. The Guo 2022 abstract offers automaticity, not this theorem; its unseen full text remains a bibliographic risk.
